messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed on /v1/embeddings (us-west-2). Pager fired for oncall primary alex. Check runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/embeds-5xx

alex: I'm primary, looking into it now. seeing ~18% 5xx over last 5m. pulling logs and KV cache metrics. will post quick findings.

priya: I'm secondary and available. ping if you need to swap or if I should jump into the incident channel.

alex: quick triage: errors look like downstream redis timeouts + occasional OOM on the quantized runner. stack traces: 
```
2025-07-12T22:10:03Z ERROR embed-worker: fetch_kv_cache failed: timeout after 500ms (redis://10.2.3.44:6379)
2025-07-12T22:10:04Z ERROR runner: allocate failed: cudamalloc OOM (device 0)
```

alex: workaround plan: 1) route traffic to dedicated fallback pool (dedicated-embeds-small) 2) scale up redis replicas or enable read-only cache fallback 3) trigger canary of quantized-v2->quantized-v1 rollback if OOM persists.

claire: ping — I can take primary custody from 22:10 UTC. alex I can be primary while you head to your flight. confirm exact handoff time?

alex: thanks. need to leave at 22:05 UTC. can you take over at 22:06? i'll handoff state and current actions.

priya: quick question: if we route to the dedicated pool, we need to ensure the client-side retry/backoff isn't increasing latency for customers. ops-runbook-bot has a note on client retry config in step 4.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook snippet added to thread: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/embeds-5xx#fallback-routing. Recommended command to shift routing (dry-run flag available):
```
# migrate a portion of traffic to dedicated pool
rwctl route set --service embeds --to dedicated-embeds-small --percent 50 --dry-run
# commit
rwctl route set --service embeds --to dedicated-embeds-small --percent 100
```

alex: doing a quick dry-run 50% now and watching error rates. also kicking off a redis pod scale up: `kubectl scale deployment redis-embeds --replicas=4 -n infra`

claire: noted. i'll be ready to take over at 22:06. once you confirm the 100% cutover and redis scale, i'll finalize incident comms and pager closure if resolved.

alex: dry-run looks good, 5xx dropped to ~6% on the portion routed. committing 100% now.

priya: monitoring client latency — p90 increased slightly from 120ms -> 160ms for routed traffic but errors dropping. tradeoff seems acceptable. :+1:

alex: redis scale started, pods coming up.

claire: I've taken primary. alex — adding short handoff note: current mitigation applied = 100% traffic to dedicated-embeds-small; redis scaled to 4 replicas; rolling restart of quantized-v2 scheduled if OOM spikes again. my contact: claire (primary) during 22:06-02:00 UTC.

alex: handing off. checklist: 
- incident summary posted to #incidents? not yet, claire pls share postmortem stub after incident closes
- key links: runbook, dashboards (https://dashboards.internal/embeds)
- outstanding: validate quantized runner memory errors; if OOM continues, initiate rollback to quantized-v1

claire: I'll post initial incident update in ~15m once we confirm stability. adding tags: customer-impact:some (search/embeds degraded), escalations:none, mitigated:partial

priya: if it helps, I'll keep an eye on the pager for the next hour and help with postmortem notes.

alex: thanks team. have to go — plane boarded. good handoff. :airplane:

ops-runbook-bot: Incident state updated: mitigated -> observed stability. Reminder: file post-incident RCA within 48h.

claire: confirmed stable at 22:40 UTC. closing the pager after one more stability window (30m). assigning RCA to priya+claire.

priya: acknowleded. I'll create the RCA skeleton and tag relevant infra/rls owners.

claire: last note: if anyone needs to contact me while primary, call +1-555-0100 or ping here with @claire.

alex: :thumbsup: last_message_ts 1745014200 (handoff complete).
